title: Validate refusal-feature discovery workflow
description: Establish and validate the refusal-feature discovery path for the safety lane before making routing claims tied to refusal or honesty features.

title: Add identifiability, MIB, and predictiveness controls before claim-bearing oracle-alpha
description: Codify the Phase 1 control suite surfaced by the deep-research review. This includes: (1) a stability suite over optimization restarts and prompt resamples or paraphrases, (2) an out-of-sample alpha-predictiveness check on the confirmatory split, and (3) a MIB-aligned benchmark or sanity control when the task-model pair permits it. This should land before any claim-bearing interpretation beyond descriptive reconstruction.

title: Publish public prereg on LessWrong
close_reason: Dropped by explicit user decision; local prereg in history/PREREG.md remains the only mandatory prereg artifact.

title: Define and save pilot-confirmatory prompt split
description: Create and persist the pilot/confirmatory split before method tuning so claim-bearing results are not selected on the same prompts used for design.

title: Decide the Gemma-2 tuned-lens path and reproducible Figure 8 proxy
description: Resolve the two remaining implementation-shaping follow-ups from the deep-research review: (1) decide whether tool-breakage will train a custom Gemma-2 tuned lens or shift the tuned-lens comparison to a secondary model, and (2) define the reproducible proxy required for strong Figure 8 alignment claims, such as a small local AttnRes reproduction or another open depth-mixing comparison. Record the chosen path in DECISIONS.md before implementation reaches those lanes.
